replay_steps: Open the ordinary signed-in Dispatch console; do not record credentials or recovery secrets.
Search calls for Community, select the community standby card, read the explicit call-filter banner and historical Call Activity.
Use Clear Filter, then clear the separate call search. They are independent controls.
Toggle Available only and inspect the unit-list result; restore it off afterward.
Search Units for Engine. Click the actual unit card, not a moving call-card resource ticker with the same name.
Select Available, explicitly retain No Destination, enter the exact unit note and verify it before Update Status.
Inspect the activity result, then open Unit Details using the card's details control to verify saved status, destination, note and crew.
Return, search Personnel for Boden, select the actual member card, and keep response status separate from Staffing.
Select Available staffing, enter the exact staffing note, verify it before Update Staffing, then inspect the app result and Personnel Details.
Restore panel searches to empty and Available only off. Preserve existing call and crew records.
